## 📊 Progress Tracking

### Implementation Checklist

**Phase 1: Planning** (1-2 days)
- [ ] Technical approach documented in PLAN.md
- [ ] Key decisions logged in DECISIONS.md
- [ ] Database schema changes planned
- [ ] API endpoints defined

**Phase 2: Development** (3-5 days)
- [ ] Core functionality implemented
- [ ] Database migrations run
- [ ] API endpoints created
- [ ] Frontend components built
- [ ] Integration complete

**Phase 3: Testing** (2-3 days)
- [ ] Unit tests written & passing
- [ ] Integration tests written & passing
- [ ] Manual testing complete
- [ ] Edge cases covered
- [ ] Production testing done

**Phase 4: Deployment** (1 day)
- [ ] Code reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Deployed to production
- [ ] Monitoring set up
- [ ] Completion summary written

## 🚀 Quick Start for Agents

**To continue work on this sprint:**

1. **Understand the Context**
   - Read this README for overview
   - Check PLAN.md for technical details
   - Review PROGRESS.md for current status

2. **Start Working**
   - Pick next task from checklist above
   - Update PROGRESS.md with daily entry
   - Log any decisions in DECISIONS.md
   - Document test results in TESTING.md

3. **Before Committing**
   - Update progress checklist
   - Add daily entry to PROGRESS.md
   - Create ADRs for significant decisions
   - Run tests and log results

4. **On Completion**
   - Fill in COMPLETION.md
   - Move folder to `.claude/archive/sprints/`
   - Create permanent docs in `docs/`
   - Update CLAUDE.md if needed
